radixDao.title: Radix DAO: Community Governance, Legal Formation & Signed Documents
radixDao.description: Explore Radix DAO LLC: Marshall Islands non-profit DAO formed on 9 October 2026. Download all 26 official signed PDFs, verify SHA-256 digests in your browser, inspect on-chain contracts, council members, and official notices.

hero.title: DAO
hero.subtitle: A non-profit Decentralized Autonomous Organization registered under Marshall Islands law, owned and directed by XRD holders. Anyone holding XRD can propose, vote, stand for election, and verify every rule on-chain.
hero.phaseBannerTitle: Radix DAO LLC is formed: Permanent RAC candidates under verification
hero.phaseBannerDesc: GP-PRE-1 passed on 2 October 2026 and Radix DAO LLC was formed on 9 October 2026. The Permanent RAC candidacy period closed on 13 November 2026 on RadixTalk; TRAC is now verifying candidates ahead of the GP-ELECT-1 vote.

facts.registrationTitle: Official registration number with MIDAO (Marshall Islands DAO registry), plus Foreign Investment Business License RMI-2026-65.
facts.statusTitle: Radix DAO LLC is legally formed, while community governance remains advisory until the GP-ACTIVATE-1 Activation Vote passes.

overview.title: Execution bodies execute.
overview.subtitle: Radix DAO LLC exists to hold and direct community resources for Radix's public goods under rules that token holders set and can amend by vote.
overview.authoritySubtitle: Token holders decide what happens; elected roles carry it out on time-bound mandates they can be voted off of.

tiers.title: Token Holders (XRD)
tiers.desc: Propose and vote on everything. Every XRD deployed across the network counts as one vote, including liquid XRD, validator LSUs, LSULP, and eligible DEX liquidity positions.

tiers.title: Accountability Council (RAC)
tiers.desc: Elected body that guards governance procedures without ruling them. A 5-seat Transition Council holds office until the Permanent Council (5–7 seats) is elected.

tiers.title: Delegated Functions
tiers.desc: Operational roles allocated by the Permanent Council from its seated members: Treasury Signers, Governance Operator, Legal Signatory, Compliance Liaison, and Web2 Custodian.

tiers.title: Working Groups
tiers.desc: Execution teams led by elected Stewards operating strictly within voter-approved charters and budgets.

overview.precedenceSubtitle: Established by Operating Agreement §11.3 and Charter §13. Where two documents conflict, the higher instrument prevails.

precedence.title: Marshall Islands Law & Certificate of Formation
precedence.desc: Statutory legal foundation and filed registration instrument.

precedence.title: Operating Agreement
precedence.desc: The Company's primary legally registered instrument; gives legal recognition to the Charter and policies.

precedence.title: Governance Charter
precedence.desc: The DAO's governance constitution, subordinate to the Operating Agreement and prevailing over all operational policies.

precedence.title: Operational Policies
precedence.desc: The 19 ratified rulebooks covering voting, treasury, roles, conduct, disputes, emergencies, contributors, code, and compliance.

precedence.title: DAO Parameters Registry
precedence.desc: Single source of truth for adjustable thresholds, quorums, time limits, and budget caps.

overview.guidesNote: Non-operative reading aids published in the official governance repository. Where a guide and a ratified document differ, the ratified document prevails.

sequence.title: Path to full
sequence.subtitle: Under the Operating Agreement, activation occurs through four transparent community milestones rather than a single vote.

steps.title: Constitutional Ratification
steps.desc: Community ratified the Charter, 20-document Policy Library, and official Signing Certificate (Activation Condition 6). All 21 signed PDFs are published with SHA-256 hashes.

steps.title: Legal Formation of Radix DAO LLC
steps.desc: Transition RAC filed the Certificate of Formation and Operating Agreement in the Marshall Islands (MIDAO #10280-26; Foreign Investment Business License RMI-2026-65 granted 8 Oct 2026). Member-managed until activation.

steps.title: Permanent RAC Election
steps.date: Candidacies closed 13 Nov 2026 · Verification in progress (16 Nov)
steps.desc: The Permanent RAC candidacy window (16 Oct – 13 Nov 2026) closed on RadixTalk with 15 community candidates. TRAC is verifying candidates via Telegram and email before opening the GP-ELECT-1 vote (5–7 seats, 6-month terms).

steps.title: Activation Vote
steps.desc: Sole binding pre-activation vote confirming all Operating Agreement Schedule 5 conditions are met. Sets the Activation Date: the Company becomes Algorithmically Governed and community votes become legally binding.

participate.title: Four ways to
participate.subtitle: Anyone holding XRD can participate, with no prior registration, no minimum balance, and no gatekeeping from any DAO body.

items.title: Propose
items.desc: Any XRD holder can submit a proposal with no minimum holding and no approval gate. Proposals move from draft discussion to a temperature check, then to a binding vote.

items.title: Vote
items.desc: 1 XRD = 1 vote, measured at the snapshot when each vote opens. Liquid XRD, validator LSUs, LSULP, and eligible Ociswap, CaviarNine, and DefiPlaza LP positions all count for their underlying XRD.

items.title: Stand for Election
items.desc: Accountability Council seats and Working Group Steward roles are open to any token holder. All terms are time-bound (6 months for Permanent RAC) and renewable only by vote.

items.title: Compliance Challenge
items.desc: There is no unilateral veto. Within 48 hours of a published result, any holder with ≥ 0.1% voting power may file a compliance challenge claiming a specific rule was broken. Filings are published verbatim within 6 hours.

people.transitionDesc: Elected in February 2026 via community approval voting to establish Radix DAO LLC and guide the transition from the Radix Foundation. Seats end automatically once the Permanent Council is seated. Three of the five also serve as legal Members of Radix DAO LLC while it is member-managed.
people.llcMemberTitle: Legal Member of Radix DAO LLC under Marshall Islands law while the entity is member-managed. This legal standing is separate from holding a Council seat.
people.councilSeatTitle: Elected member of the Transition Accountability Council without separate legal Member standing in the LLC.
people.councilTelegramTitle: Open Telegram channel where Radix Accountability Council members publish updates and proceedings.
people.permanentDesc: The standing guardian body under the ratified RAC Mandate (2 Oct 2026). The candidacy window closed on 13 November 2026 on RadixTalk with 15 community applicants (including sitting TRAC members); as of 16 November, TRAC is verifying candidates ahead of opening the GP-ELECT-1 vote. The Permanent RAC cannot override valid votes and must propose an independent treasury auditor in its first quarter.
people.candidatesDesc: Community members who submitted their candidacy on RadixTalk during the official window (16 Oct to 13 Nov 2026). TRAC is verifying each candidate via Telegram and email before opening the vote.
people.candidateTracTitle: Currently serving on the Transition Radix Accountability Council (TRAC) and running for a seat on the Permanent RAC.
people.candidateCommunityTitle: Independent community candidate who submitted an application during the official Permanent RAC candidacy window.

verify.title: Don't take our word.
verify.subtitle: Every live governance contract, badge, and treasury account is verifiable on the Radix ledger, and every signed PDF can be hash-checked locally in your browser.
verify.registrySubtitle: Pending accounts are shown transparently so the register always reflects the DAO's real on-chain state.
verify.statusLiveTitle: Deployed on Radix Mainnet and publicly verifiable via the Radix Dashboard.
verify.statusPendingTitle: Reserved in the ratified On-Chain Identifiers Policy, not yet deployed on Radix Mainnet.
verify.certDesc: All 21 ratified governance PDFs and all 5 formation record PDFs carry a signature from this single certificate ratified in GP-PRE-1.
verify.checkerDesc: Drop any Radix DAO PDF below or choose a file. Its SHA-256 digest is computed directly in your browser using the Web Crypto API, and the file is never uploaded.
verify.checkerDropCta: Drop a governance PDF here, or click to select

verify.checkerMatchDesc: Byte-for-byte SHA-256 match with the official ratified/filed record:

notices.title: Latest notices
notices.subtitle: Resolutions, meeting minutes, and process notices published on radixdao.org/notices, alongside the active GitHub repositories under RadixDAO.
notices.defaultSummary: Official record published in the Radix DAO notices registry. Open the official source below for the full text.

summaries.2026-11-13-notice-of-non-elevation-tempe: The Transition RAC formally determined that Temperature Check #2 ("Burn or disable Radix Works XRD tokens") will not advance to a binding Governance Proposal. The signed resolution document details the constitutional and procedural grounds for non-elevation.
summaries.2026-11-10-minutes-of-trac-meeting-on-no: Signed minutes of the formal Transition RAC meeting held on 7 November 2026, recording decisions regarding the handover of mobile Store Apps control (iOS / Android) and the evaluation of Temperature Check #2.
summaries.2026-10-31-transition-rac-meeting-minute: Signed minutes of the 12 October 2026 Transition RAC meeting documenting the legal incorporation of Radix DAO LLC (filed 9 October 2026, MIDAO 10280-26) and subsequent operational steps.
summaries.2026-08-29-transition-rac-s-decisions-to: Full signed minutes of the 25 August 2026 Transition RAC meeting detailing all discussions and formal decisions adopted to enable and support the GP-PRE-1 Constitutional Ratification vote.
summaries.2026-08-29-transition-rac-certificate-te: Technical specification of the digital signing certificate created and operated by the Transition RAC during the transition period, enabling independent verification of non-repudiation and tamper-proofing across all signed DAO PDFs.

notices.reposSubtitle: Open-source repositories maintained under github.com/RadixDAO. The commit history of governance-framework serves as the public governance audit trail.

contact.title: Reach the
contact.subtitle: Two monitored mailboxes reach the Accountability Council directly for compliance challenges, disputes, and formal notices.
contact.mailboxNote: The veto@ mailbox intentionally retains its legacy name so filers who remember it still reach a monitored channel.
contact.challengeDesc: If you hold at least 0.1% of voting power and believe a published decision broke a specific governance rule, email either mailbox within 48 hours of the result. Filings are published verbatim to the public record within 6 hours.
contact.knownGapDesc: No official DAO discussion platform has been designated yet. Individual Transition Council members are reachable on Telegram, but personal handles are not official DAO channels and nothing said there is on the formal record.
contact.legalDisclaimer: Radix DAO LLC is a non-profit Decentralized Autonomous Organization LLC registered under Marshall Islands law (MIDAO 10280-26), and is a separate legal entity from Radix Publishing Ltd.
